description.value: Sacrificial ceramic plates. Resistance 5 to B/P/S; drops by 1 each time you take physical damage (min 0), resetting to 5 after a 10-minute rest.

cinderfall.incomplete: The drop-by-1-per-hit / reset-after-10-minutes mechanic has no precedent anywhere in pf2e: 'ablative' returns zero hits across the entire engine source and compendium (checked, not just this schema), so there is no degrading-resistance rule element to build on. Granting the flat Resistance 5 above and leaving the degrade unmodeled overstates the card less than omitting it entirely would understate it, but it is a real approximation, not a full implementation -- noted here rather than silently accepted.
